name: Loveressive
source:
On Valentine’s day, Kaname was confessed to by four girls at the same time: carefree childhood friend Kotora, blonde rich transfer student Reo, airheaded genius kouhai Ryou, and small meddlesome senpai Mao. They vowed to try to make him love them before White Day. His objections would not waver the resolves of these aggressive girls who are after their man.

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/02/01/february-2013-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
情人节当天，要同时收到四名女孩的告白：我行我素的青梅竹马小虎、金发的大小姐转学生玲、迷糊的天才学妹凉，以及爱管闲事的小个子学姐真央。她们发誓要在白色情人节前让要爱上自己。面对这些主动出击、认定要就是自己目标的女孩，他的拒绝也无法动摇她们的决心。

[来自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/02/01/february-2013-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
